title: Air Fryer Beyond Meat Brats, Onions, and Peppers
description: Beyond Meat brats are sliced, mixed with bell peppers and onions, and air-fried to crispy perfection in this simple air fryer recipe.
ingredients: 2 links vegetarian bratwurst sausage (such as Beyond Meat®), sliced
0.5 green bell pepper, sliced into thin strips
0.5 red bell pepper, sliced into thin strips
1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the air fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine vegetarian sausage slices, onion, bell peppers, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; stir to coat. Pour mixture into the basket of the air fryer.
Cook in the preheated air fryer for 10 minutes. Shake the basket and cook for 5 more minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of sausage should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
